heading: 16.2 Module catalogue
text:
### 16.2 Module catalogue [LUNI.16.2]

#### `units.si`

SI base units, all explicitly-prefixed derived names, and SI derived units.
Follows the SI 9th edition (2019) exactly. No algorithmic prefix expansion —
all prefixed forms (`kilogram`, `milliampere`, `megohm`, `MHz`, etc.) are
declared explicitly.

Dimensions covered: `length`, `mass`, `time`, `temperature`, `current`,
`luminous_intensity`, `amount`, `frequency`, `radioactivity`,
`force`, `energy`, `power`, `pressure`, `voltage`, `resistance`,
`conductance`, `capacitance`, `inductance`, `charge`, `magnetic_flux`,
`magnetic_flux_density`, `absorbed_dose`, `equivalent_dose`, `illuminance`,
`luminous_flux`, `luminance`, `catalytic_activity`, `area`, `volume`,
`velocity`, `acceleration`, `solid_angle`.

Scalars covered: `angle`, `proportion`.

#### `units.metric`

Non-SI units officially accepted for use with the SI (BIPM 9th ed, Table 8),
plus universally-used metric-adjacent units.

| Unit | Value | Alias |
|---|---|---|
| `litre` | 0.001 m³ | `L` |
| `millilitre` | 0.000001 m³ | `mL` |
| `tonne` | 1000 kg | `t` |
| `hectare` | 10,000 m² | `ha` |
| `bar` | 100,000 Pa | — |
| `millibar` | 100 Pa | `mbar` |
| `angstrom` | 1×10⁻¹⁰ m | `Å` |
| `astronomical_unit` | 149,597,870,700 m (exact) | `au` |
| `electronvolt` | 1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹ J (exact) | `eV` |
| `dalton` | 1.66053906660×10⁻²⁷ kg | `Da` |
| `kilocalorie` | 4186.8 J (IT) | `kcal` |
| `metric_horsepower` | 735.49875 W (exact) | `PS` |

#### `units.customary`

US customary units. Length units here are shared with UK (inch, foot, yard,
mile are identical in both systems since the International Yard and Pound
Agreement, 1959).

**Length:** `inch` (25.4 mm), `foot` (304.8 mm), `yard` (0.9144 m),
`mile` (1609.344 m), `mil` (25.4 µm), `thou` = `mil`.

**Mass (avoirdupois — declared here, at `units.avoirdupois`'s values):**
`grain`, `dram`, `ounce`, `pound`, `short_hundredweight` (100 lb),
`short_ton` (2000 lb).

**Volume (liquid):** `fluid_ounce` (29.5735295625 mL), `cup` (236.5882365 mL),
`pint` (473.176473 mL), `quart` (946.352946 mL), `gallon` (3.785411784 L).

**Volume (dry):** `dry_pint` (550.6104713575 mL), `dry_quart`
(1101.220942715 mL), `peck` (8810.56754172 mL), `bushel` (35242.2701669 mL),
alias `bu`. Dry and liquid measure share the `volume` dimension and have
distinct unit names.

**Temperature:** `fahrenheit`, `rankine`.

**Pressure:** `psi` (6894.757293168 Pa — absolute only; see §7 note on gauge).

**Power:** `mechanical_horsepower` (745.69987158227022 W), alias `hp`.

**Speed:** `miles_per_hour`, alias `mph`.

#### `units.imperial`

UK imperial units. Length is not duplicated here — import `units.customary`
for inch/foot/yard/mile (identical values).

**Mass:** `stone` (6.35029318 kg), `long_hundredweight` (50.80234544 kg,
112 lb), `long_ton` (1016.0469088 kg, 2240 lb).

**Volume:** `imperial_fluid_ounce` (28.4130625 mL), `imperial_pint`
(568.26125 mL), `imperial_quart` (1136.5225 mL), `imperial_gallon`
(4546.09 mL).

#### `units.avoirdupois`

The avoirdupois mass system used across US and UK for general commerce.

| Unit | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `grain` | 64.79891 mg (exact) | shared with `units.troy` |
| `dram` | 1.7718451953125 g | 27+11/32 grains |
| `ounce` | 28.349523125 g (exact) | avoirdupois ounce |
| `pound` | 453.59237 g (exact) | |
| `short_hundredweight` | 45.359237 kg | 100 lb, US |
| `long_hundredweight` | 50.80234544 kg | 112 lb, UK |
| `short_ton` | 907.18474 kg | 2000 lb, US |
| `long_ton` | 1016.0469088 kg | 2240 lb, UK |

#### `units.troy`

Troy mass system used for precious metals and gemstones.

| Unit | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `grain` | 64.79891 mg (exact) | shared with `units.avoirdupois` |
| `pennyweight` | 1.55517384 g | 24 grains |
| `troy_ounce` | 31.1034768 g (exact) | |
| `troy_pound` | 373.2417216 g | 12 troy ounces |

#### `units.nautical`

International nautical units. All defined in exact SI.

| Unit | Value | Alias |
|---|---|---|
| `nautical_mile` | 1852 m (exact) | `nmi` |
| `knot` | 1852/3600 m/s (exact) | `kn` |
| `fathom` | 1.8288 m (exact) | — |
| `cable` | 185.2 m (exact) | — |
| `nautical_league` | 5556 m (exact) | — |

#### `units.time`

Extension of the `time` dimension beyond the units [LUNI.10.2] declares.

| Unit | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `week` | 604,800,000,000,000 ns | 7 days (exact) |
| `fortnight` | 1,209,600,000,000,000 ns | 14 days (exact) |
| `year_julian` | 31,557,600,000,000,000 ns | 365.25 days (exact) |
| `year_gregorian` | 31,556,952,000,000,000 ns | 365.2425 days (exact) |
| `year_tropical` | 31,556,925,974,880,000 ns | 365.24219878… days (float64, not exact Rational) |

`year_tropical` is irrational with respect to SI base units, so its conversion
factor cannot be expressed as an exact Rational (§2); the float64-derived value
is rounded at compile time to the pinned `int64` nanosecond constant shown
above, which is then the **exact stored representation** at runtime — no
runtime float is involved. The "float64" note refers to *factor derivation*,
not the stored value.

#### `units.electrical`

Non-SI electromagnetic units. All SI-named electrical units (ohm, farad,
henry, siemens, coulomb, weber, tesla with all prefixes) are declared in
`units.si` — import that first. `units.electrical` adds CGS survivors and
the electrical horsepower definition.

Notable units: `gauss` (10⁻⁴ T), `maxwell` (10⁻⁸ Wb),
`electrical_horsepower` (746 W exactly, IEEE Std 100).

#### `units.audio`

Units for audio and psychoacoustics.

**Power-referenced dB (interconvertible scalar group `power_db`):**
`dBm`, `dBW`, `dBf`, `dBk`.

**Voltage-referenced dB (interconvertible scalar group `voltage_db`):**
`dBu`, `dBV`.

**Standalone scalars ([LUNI.6.2]), each unit the single member of its own
group:** `dB` (`generic_db`), `dBFS` (`full_scale_db`), `dBc` (`carrier_db`),
`dBSPL` (`spl_db`), `dBi` (`antenna_gain_db`).

**Power:** the `implicit` formula pair `dBm_watt` ([LUNI.4.5]):
`dBm_to_watt` is $10^{x/10} / 1000$ and `watt_to_dBm` is
$10 \log_{10}(1000\,x)$, between `dBm` and `units.si`'s `watt`.

**Loudness (dimension `loudness`):** `sone`, the base; `phon`, tier-2
non-affine ([LUNI.4.3]), with `to_base` $2^{(x - 40)/10}$ and `from_base`
$10 \log_2 x + 40$. The conversion is defined at every value; the
psychoacoustic relation it encodes holds at 40 phon and above.

**Musical pitch:** `midi_note`, a `Float` note number (fractional values
represent tunings between semitones); the formula pair `midi_hz`
([LUNI.4.5]): `midi_to_hz` is $440 \cdot 2^{(x - 69)/12}$ and `hz_to_midi` is
$69 + 12 \log_2(x / 440)$, between `midi_note` and `units.si`'s `Hz`.

#### `units.chemistry`

Units for chemical and laboratory contexts.

| Unit | Dimension | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `molar` | `molarity` | mol/L |
| `millimolar` | `molarity` | 0.001 mol/L |
| `micromolar` | `molarity` | 1×10⁻⁶ mol/L |
| `nanomolar` | `molarity` | 1×10⁻⁹ mol/L |
| `molar_h` | `acidity` | base: hydrogen-ion concentration, mol/L |
| `pH` | `acidity` | tier-2 non-affine ([LUNI.4.3]): `to_base` $10^{-x}$, `from_base` $-\log_{10} x$ |
| `ppm` | `proportion` | 1×10⁻⁶ (dimensionless scalar) |
| `ppb` | `proportion` | 1×10⁻⁹ |
| `ppt` | `proportion` | 1×10⁻¹² (IUPAC; see note in file on oceanographic usage) |

#### `units.physics`

Compound physical dimensions requiring explicit naming in DS's no-unit-algebra
system, and CGS legacy units common in datasheets.

New dimensions: `torque` (≠ `energy`, both N·m), `angular_velocity` (≠
`frequency`, both 1/s), `dynamic_viscosity`, `kinematic_viscosity`,
`heat_capacity`, `specific_heat`, `thermal_conductivity`, `electric_field`,
`surface_charge`.

Notable units: `rpm`, `centipoise` (cP), `centistokes` (cSt), `curie`
(3.7×10¹⁰ Bq), `erg` (10⁻⁷ J), `dyne` (10⁻⁵ N), `rad_dose` (0.01 Gy —
named `rad_dose` to avoid collision with the `rad` alias for radian).

#### `units.astro`

Astronomical units for embedded systems interacting with instruments: telescope
mount controllers, satellite ground stations, radio telescope pipelines,
spacecraft telemetry. Cosmological-scale quantities explicitly out of scope.
Conforms to IAU 2015 Resolution B3 nominal mass constants.

Notable units: `light_year`, `parsec`, `kiloparsec`, `milliarcsecond` (`mas`),
`microarcsecond` (`µas`), `solar_mass`, `earth_mass`, `jupiter_mass`,
`lunar_mass`, `jansky` (`Jy`), `millijansky`, `microjansky`.

#### `units.computer`

Computer engineering units for embedded firmware and real-time rules.
Follows IEC 80000-13 binary/decimal prefix split; no `KB` alias (ambiguous).

Dimensions: `data` (int64/bit base), `data_rate`, `symbol_rate` (baud ≠ bps),
`energy_per_bit`, `energy_per_flop`, `energy_per_mac`, `energy_per_instruction`,
`compute_efficiency`, `request_rate` (RPS), `transaction_rate` (TPS) and
`query_rate` (QPS), each ≠ the others, ≠ Hz, ≠ Bq.

Notable units: IEC `KiB`–`PiB`, SI `kB`–`PB`, `baud`/`kBd`/`MBd`,
`light_nanosecond` (≈ 29.98 cm), `light_picosecond`, `nJ_per_bit`,
`pJ_per_flop`, `pJ_per_mac`, `TOPS_per_watt`. Inverting formula pair:
`energy_per_flop` ↔ `compute_efficiency`.
